question: In which battle did a small French force defeat a much larger army of the Nawab of Carnatic, Anwar-ud-din, demonstrating the superiority of European military discipline in 1746?
options: Battle of St. Thome (Battle of Adyar)
explanation: In the Battle of St. Thome (or Adyar) in 1746, a small French force of about 230 Europeans and 700 sepoys under Captain Paradis defeated a 10,000-strong army of Nawab Anwar-ud-din led by his son Mahfuz Khan. This was a turning point that exposed the weakness of traditional Indian armies against disciplined European troops.

question: Which rich coastal region of Andhra Pradesh was ceded to the French by the Nizam of Hyderabad, Salabat Jung, in 1753 to maintain French troops under Bussy?
explanation: In 1753, Salabat Jung (Nizam of Hyderabad) ceded the Northern Circars (coastal districts of Andhra Pradesh) to the French under Bussy to meet the expenses of the French military contingent stationed at his court.
